name: Swoop title and icons
what: A glowing title whose letters swoop in one after another from below, big and blurred, while a small gold crown drops onto its end; the camera then pans up so a white subtitle comes in pixelated and sharpens, and a heart and a coin rise from the bottom and settle with a glow.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f20 (00:00:00:02-00:00:00:20) the title's letters swoop in left to right from below, big and blurred, shrinking onto the line; f24-f38 (00:00:00:24-00:00:01:08) a gold crown drops onto its left end and settles; f54-f94 (00:00:01:24-00:00:03:04) the camera pans up and in (fastest f62-f66) so the title leaves through the top and dims; f68-f92 (00:00:02:08-00:00:03:02) the white subtitle comes in pixelated and sharpens; f134-f150 (00:00:04:14-00:00:05:00) the camera pans again to put the subtitle high; f156-f176 (00:00:05:06-00:00:05:26) a heart then a coin rise from the bottom, dim and blurred, and settle with a glow; hold to f210 (00:00:07:00). Everything moves on twos except the first pan.

tracks.name: letters swoop
tracks.what: the title's letters swoop in left to right from below, big and blurred, shrinking onto the line

tracks.name: crown drop
tracks.what: a gold crown drops onto the title's left end and bounces once

tracks.what: the title moves up and grows, leaving through the top and dimming

tracks.name: subtitle

tracks.what: the camera pans again so the subtitle sits high

tracks.name: heart rises
tracks.what: a heart rises from the bottom, dim and blurred, and settles with a small overshoot

tracks.name: coin rises

tracks.name: hold
